author: ekomzo

title: css(): @property, @font-face and other descriptor at-rules are nested inside the class rule
author: brookslybrand
body_preview: ### Reproduction  `css()` hoists `@keyframes` and `@function` out of the class rule, but every other at-rule is nested with the element selector. For at-rules whose body is descriptors rather than rules (`@property`, `@font-face`, `@counter-style`, `@font-palette-values`, `@page`), that output is invalid, so the browser drops it. title: component: an undefined or null host prop removes its attribute on every render
author: brookslybrand
body_preview: ### Reproduction  A host prop passed as `undefined` (or `null`) removes its attribute on **every** render, even when the previous value was also `undefined`. Any attribute browser code sets on that element (a third-party script, `toggleAttribute()`, an animation helper) is wiped by the next unrelated `handle.update()`. title: Session flash messages can disappear across server-rendered frames
author: brophdawg11
body_preview: ## Problem  Session flash messages can disappear while rendering nested frames.  Internal frame requests forward credentials and independently run session middleware.
